beats.headline: Two of forty
beats.text: Miriam Dom is a pile of dust, and beside it stands a stack of everything she owned, dumped from her inventory because she feared turning to dust would make her body unlootable. She was right. She told Carl he could take a few items for helping her, and he promised it would all go to Prepotente. He intends to keep that promise. Mostly. Among the potions and plants are over forty scrolls of something called Size Up. He walks out of Prepotente's sight and takes two. As the second goes into his inventory, his interface flickers, and the number 50 slams into place.

beats.headline: Payment for the scrolls
beats.text: Prepotente needs at least five more fine healing potions for the recipe his benefactor box just sent him. Carl has about fifty and says he has a few. Give them to me, says the goat: consider it payment for the Size Up scrolls you stole from my mother. Carl pauses, then asks to hear what is on the paper first, and once he has, hands over five potions without further complaint.

beats.headline: A look at Osvaldo
beats.text: While they wait, Donut downs a Size Up potion and watches the back of Osvaldo's head. Then she reports. His dexterity is really high, 285 with all his buffs. He has a Deflector ability, and his Jump skill is level fifteen. Carl asks about Puddle Jump or Phase: he has Puddle Jump, but only at level eight, which means a ten-second countdown.

beats.headline: Protected from examination
beats.text: In the Desperado Club's casino the croupier is level 120 and an Enforcer, his examination full of redactions, a much higher level than Carl expected. Carl tells Donut to take a Size Up and asks anyone else with examination skills to let him know what they see. Donut reports back that he is protected from the examination.
